content_sections.heading: KRCL Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the KRCL Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download KRCL Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Junior Technical Assistant: Full time Degree / Diploma in Civil Engineering from recognized (AICTE) University/Institute. Minimum 2 years of experience in Railway projects such as planning/field survey/preparation of DPR/ Supervision of construction of Civil Engineering works in Building/ Highways/ Railways/Metros preferably in a Rly/PSU/reputed private company. Candidate should have knowledge of the relevant specification i.e. Railway Board & RDSO and other relevant codes & specifications. Junior Technical Assistant / Design & Drawing: Full time Degree / Diploma in Civil Engineering from recognized (AICTE) University/Institute. Two years of experience in Civil Engineering and additional qualification for working in Auto CAD and Computer knowledge in Word and Excel etc. Candidate should have knowledge of the relevant specification i.e. Railway Board & RDSO and other relevant codes & specifications.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for KRCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Junior Technical Assistant posts at Konkan Railway Corporation Limited (KRCL) is scheduled for 25 August 2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue on time with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Technical Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Full-time Degree or Diploma in Civil Engineering from a recognized (AICTE) University/Institute to be eligible for the Junior Technical Assistant positions.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Technical Assistant position?
faq.answer: Konkan Railway Corporation Limited (KRCL) has announced a total of 8 vacancies for the Junior Technical Assistant posts. These are distributed across two specific roles within the Junior Technical Assistant category.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Junior Technical Assistant posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all Junior Technical Assistant posts is 35 years as of 01 July 2026. Age relaxation is applicable for SC candidates.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for the KRCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for the Junior Technical Assistant recruitment at Konkan Railway Corporation Limited (KRCL). This applies to all categories, including General, OBC, SC, and ST candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Junior Technical Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Junior Technical Assistant posts will receive a consolidated remuneration ranging from Rs. 41,380 to Rs. 47,220 per month, depending on the class of the city.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a preliminary screening followed by a walk-in interview conducted by a nominated committee. A merit list will be prepared based on the candidate's performance, qualifications, and experience.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies (ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, category certificate if applicable), and recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the walk-in interview be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra, with the pincode 400614. The exact venue details will be available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The Junior Technical Assistant positions at Konkan Railway Corporation Limited (KRCL) are on a contract basis.
